note: Reuses frozen ErrorCode values; message_key values are module-owned. CSV formula injection is neutralized at parse time (tab or apostrophe prefix); it is not an error row.

rows.when: Actor lacks imports.validate, imports.commit, reports.read, reports.export, or reportcards.generate.
Sensitive bulk commit or export requires recent 2FA and fixture says stale.
Guardian link revoked or relationship no longer grants read; download URL must not be issued.
Absent job, report, template, or other-school resource. Cross-school always 404.
validation_version stale after concurrent validate or template bump.
Commit source_digest does not match stored file digest for the import job.
Commit, download, or report fetch while job is still validating, committing, or failed.
Malformed body, unknown field, or closed-schema rejection.
Body carried school_id, actor_id, or ResourceGrant.
dataset not in the module allowlist for imports, exports, or reports.
Export or import row referenced a column or field not permitted for the actor or dataset.
